universe: roster players with a MiLB line in the feature season, age 25 or under, no MLB line, and no label-source opinion dated on or before 2026-10-02

columns.p_<set>_<window>: served P(first grade from the set within the window), recency-shifted; sets any (all label sources), fg (FanGraphs), mlbp (MLB Pipeline incl. international)
columns.p_any_<window>_raw: the ANY P before the recency shift (what a freeze keeps); every head's raw total is in heads
columns.fv_first_fg: expected first FV if FanGraphs grades the player, FanGraphs scale (35+ = 37.5)
columns.fv_first_mlbp: expected first FV if MLB Pipeline grades the player, Pipeline scale
